preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n representing the number of words, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5.
The second line contains exactly n words separated by single spaces.
Each word in the sentence is non-empty.
The total length of all words does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join([stdin.split()[0]] + stdin.split()[1:]) if int(stdin.split()[0]) == 1 else stdout == merge_words(stdin.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: If there is only one word, the output is the word itself. Otherwise, the output is the result of merging all words left to right, where merging two words removes the longest prefix of the second word that matches a suffix of the first word.
